spec.title: VF-010's reproducer at the fix: Pricing#total's regression proof on the own checker finds the violation in 8 of 8 runs (closes VF-010 with the integration-tests job)
spec.description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md): the own checker's branch probes were given wall-clock time (as long as the solver calls so far took, at least a second), so which side of a branch stayed undecided depended on the machine, and Pricing#total's regression proof found its violation on some runs and ran out of time on others. The fix (cleanup loop, native stream, item N1) budgets each probe in solver conflicts instead: as many as all the calls so far had, at least 10,000 (Engine::probe and PROBE_CONFLICTS in lib/src/bmc/mod.rs; CaDiCaL's conflicts counted as the clauses it learns and the call stopped through its terminate callback, lib/src/bmc/sat.rs). The run's deadline stays the user's --timeout. This job runs the reproducer lib/tests/reproducers/vf-010.sh unchanged from job 20261107-163057 (which ran it before the fix, expecting exit 1): 8 runs of 'jvmcontract equivalence --target fixtures.Pricing#total --engine native --timeout 40', exit 0 only when all 8 find the violation. With job 'VF-010's integration tests at the fix' it closes VF-010 when both pass.
spec.expected: exit 0: all 8 runs find the violation, each with the same numbers (6 paths, 12 solver calls, 1 of 2 divisions built in full, 358609 clauses as here)
